conservative_hold.description: Gentle, long-only accumulation. Buys a small % of cash only when risk is low-to-mid; stops buying by mid risk. Never sells. Hand-authored personality, not optimized.

balanced.description: Moderate, long-only accumulation across a wider low-to-mid risk band, tapering to zero by mid-high risk. Never sells. Hand-authored personality, not optimized.

aggressive_accumulate.description: Aggressive, long-only accumulation: high buy rates at low risk, decaying slowly through mid risk. Never sells. Hand-authored personality, not optimized.

accumulate_and_distribute.description: Full accumulation + distribution: buys through low-to-mid risk, holds flat through the value zone, sells into high risk. The BTC-reference signed curve (sdca/curve.py DEFAULT_BTC_NODES). Hand-authored personality, not optimized.
